cards.text: It's the eighth month of the second year of Darius, king of Persia (Ezra 4:24), and the word of the LORD comes to the prophet Zechariah son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo. That's a full name AND a family tree, friend. My whole name is five letters carved into a handle.

cards.question: Before anything else, the LORD tells Zechariah how He felt about the people's fathers. True or false: He was very pleased with them.

cards.text: So the LORD of Hosts gives Zechariah a message to pass on to the people. Zechariah is now the one posting the big update in the group chat and watching for those little 'seen' checkmarks.

cards.question: The LORD of Hosts calls the people to come back to Him. If they do, what does He promise?
Then the LORD gives the people a warning: Do not be like your ___.

cards.text: The former prophets brought the fathers a message from the LORD of Hosts: 'Turn now from your evil ways and deeds.'

cards.question: The former prophets told the fathers to turn from their evil ways and deeds. How did the fathers respond?

cards.text: Then God asks two questions: 'Where are your fathers now? And the prophets, do they live forever?'

cards.question: God has asked where the fathers are now and whether the prophets live forever. Next, He asks whether something of His overtook the fathers. What does He name?
True or false: when the LORD's words and statutes caught up with the fathers, they repented.
When the fathers repented, what did they say about what the LORD of Hosts had done to them?

answers.text: He did just what He had purposed
He went harder on them than He said
He gave them less than they earned
